{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

example (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64)
    (h : isAllowed to p.allowed = false) : step p s now to amount = (.denyReceiver, s) := by
  unfold Wallet.step
  rw [h]
  rfl

end Solution
